question_text: An investigator is attempting to develop a blood test to diagnose sporadic Creutzfeld-Jacob disease (CJD). She has collected several tissue samples from adults who were diagnosed with CJD. After performing a comprehensive tissue analysis, she has identified two amino acid sequences on the affected proteins that are highly consistent across samples. She then creates antibodies that are highly specific to those amino acid sequences and is interested in using those antibodies to identify similar sequences in individuals suspected of having CJD. Which of the following tests would be most helpful in identifying these individuals?

                    ### Question
                    An investigator is attempting to develop a blood test to diagnose sporadic Creutzfeld-Jacob disease (CJD). She has collected several tissue samples from adults who were diagnosed with CJD. After performing a comprehensive tissue analysis, she has identified two amino acid sequences on the affected proteins that are highly consistent across samples. She then creates antibodies that are highly specific to those amino acid sequences and is interested in using those antibodies to identify similar sequences in individuals suspected of having CJD. Which of the following tests would be most helpful in identifying these individuals?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Southern blot
opb. Western blot
opc. Northern blot
opd. Southwestern blot
ope. Polymerase chain reaction

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
The most helpful test in identifying individuals suspected of having sporadic Creutzfeld-Jacob disease (CJD) would be the Western blot. This test utilizes antibodies specific to the identified amino acid sequences on affected proteins to detect proteins with similar sequences in suspected CJD individuals, aiding in the diagnosis of CJD. The evidence paths linking antibodies to symptoms and disease predisposition in Creutzfeldt-Jakob Syndrome do not directly support the diagnostic utility of Western blot but highlight the role of antibodies in disease processes.
